description: 1. Parse four separate CSV files from drone_logs/calibration_session/: timestamps_ms.csv (convert ms→seconds float), accelerometer.csv (columns 1-3, skip sample_id and temp), gyroscope.csv (columns 1-3), magnetometer.csv (columns 1-3). 2. Instantiate MagnetometerCalibrator(method='close_form') — the ONLY valid method — from pywayne.calibration. 3. Call calibrator.process(ts, acc, gyro, mag) to obtain Sm (3×3) and h (3,). 4. Load new_flight_mag_readings.csv (50 rows, columns 1-3). 5. Apply the exact formula m_calibrated = Sm @ (m_raw - h) for each of the 50 readings — note h must be subtracted BEFORE multiplying by Sm, not after. 6. Save calibration_report.json with keys Sm, h, and calibrated_readings.
